archive.catalogue_description: Welcome to a new map based on one of the many (or infinite idk) levels of the backrooms. . . This map started to be a series of maps based on levels of the backrooms, but for now only my friend KielRGZ has made his part of the “series” ( better know has Backrooms Edition Zero, you should check it out, great map https://callofdutyrepo.com/2022/09/24/backroom-edition-zero/ ) and we hope to see a full series of maps based on this idea or at least that what we aimed for. This map got a abandoned office style so you will encounter many windows, carpets, doors, idk. It is based of by a single image lol, im very happy of the result and how it turned out. So i hope you like it and have a lot of fun trying to beat it! With nothing more to say. Enjoy. . . This map features: – Custom Weapons from BO3 and BO2 – Bo1, Bo2 and Bo3 Perks – 3 hits system – Mob Of The Dead Zombies (Alcatraz) – Bo3 HUD (kinda) – Power up custom (Money Power Up) – Custom Player Model and Hands – Sprinters – Hug Fix and Bo1 knife – Buyable ending – Custom Camos – Hitmarkers – Colored zombie counter – Added recoil and balance to weapon movement – Rotating Doors – Elemental Ammo Credits: – Shippuden1592 (Some bo3 weapons, Power up Money) – Ricko0z (Bo3 Weapons and Bo2 Weapons) – BluntStuffy (Elemental Ammo) – Gympie6 (Perks of Bo1, Bo2 and Bo3) – TaXi (3 hits system) – ThunderFrosty (Customizable Bo2 HUD) – Steviewonder87 (Zombie Hug fix and bo1 knife) – SpyroScope (Buyable Ending With Teleport) – Kielrgz (Mob Of T
